function create_initial_solution(n)
    T = zeros(n, n)
    hot_temp=100
    cold_temp=10
    T[1, :] .= hot_temp
    T[n,:] .= hot_temp
    T[:,1].= hot_temp
    T[:,n].= cold_temp
    return T
end

function jacobi_laplace(T, maxiter=1000, tol=1e-6)
    n = size(T,1)  
    m = size(T,2)
    T_next=copy(T)
    delta_tab = []

    for iter in 1:maxiter
        delta = 0.0
        for j in 2:n-1
            for i in 2:m-1
                T_next[i, j] = 0.25 * (T[i-1, j] + T[i+1, j] +  T[i, j-1] + T[i, j+1])
                delta = max(delta, abs(T_next[i, j] - T[i, j]))
            end
        end
        T, T_next = T_next, T
        push!(delta_tab, (delta))

        if delta < tol
            return T, iter, delta_tab
        end
    end
    return T, NaN, delta_tab
end

function gauss_seidel(T, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-6)
    n = size(T,1)  
    m = size(T,2)
    delta_tab = []
    T_next=copy(T)
    for iter in 1:max_iter
        delta = 0.0
        for i in 2:n-1
            for j in 2:m-1
                T_next[i, j] = 0.25 * (T_next[i, j-1] + T_next[i-1, j] + T[i+1, j] + T[i, j+1])
                delta = max(delta, abs(T_next[i, j] - T[i, j]))
            end
        end

        T, T_next = T_next, T
        push!(delta_tab, (delta))

        if delta < tol
            return T, iter, delta_tab
        end
    end
    return T, NaN, delta_tab
end

function sor(T, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-6)
    n = size(T,1)  
    m = size(T,2)
    T_next=copy(T)
    delta_tab = []
    omega = 2 / (1 + sqrt(1-cos(pi/n)^2)) 
    for iter in 1:max_iter
        delta = 0.0
        for i in 2:n-1
            for j in 2:m-1
                T_next[i, j] = (1-omega) * T[i,j] + omega * 0.25 * (T_next[i, j-1] + T_next[i-1, j] + T[i+1, j] + T[i, j+1])
                delta = max(delta, abs(T_next[i, j] - T[i, j]))
            end
        end

        T, T_next = T_next, T
        
        push!(delta_tab, (delta))
        
        if delta < tol
            return T, iter, delta_tab
        end
    end
    return T, NaN, delta_tab
end

In [6]:
function chebyshev(T, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-6)
    n, m = size(T)
    T_next = copy(T)
    rho2 = cos(pi / n)^2
    delta_tab = []
    omega_odd = 1.0
    omega_even = 1.0 / (1 - 0.5 * rho2)

    for iter in 1:max_iter
        delta = 0.0
        for i in 2:n-1
            for j in 2:m-1
                if (i + j) % 2 == 1
                    omega = omega_odd
                else
                    omega = omega_odd
                end
                T_next[i, j] = (1 - omega) * T[i, j] + omega * 0.25 * (
                    T[i+1, j] + T_next[i-1, j] + T[i, j+1] + T_next[i, j-1]
                )
                delta = max(delta, abs(T_next[i, j] - T[i, j]))
            end
        end

        omega_odd = 1 / (1 - 0.25 * rho2 * omega_even)
        omega_even = 1 / (1 - 0.25 * rho2 * omega_odd)

        T, T_next = T_next, T
        
        push!(delta_tab, (delta))

        if delta < tol
            return T, iter, delta_tab
        end
    end
    return T, NaN, delta_tab
end

function ratios(data) 
    return reverse(cumsum(reverse(data))) ./ sum(data)
end

function sor_poisson_2d(N::Int, source_term::Float64, ω::Float64, tol::Float64, max_iter::Int)
    u = zeros(N, N)
    u_new = copy(u)
    coeff = (1/N)^2 * source_term / 4.0
    errors = Float64[]
    
    println("Rozpoczynam iteracje SOR...")
    
    for iter in 1:max_iter
        max_change = 0.0
        for i in 2:N-1
            for j in 2:N-1
                u_gs = 0.25 * (u[i+1,j] + u[i-1,j] + u[i,j+1] + u[i,j-1]) + coeff
                u_new[i,j] = (1 - ω) * u[i,j] + ω * u_gs
                change = abs(u_new[i,j] - u[i,j])
                max_change = max(max_change, change)
                u[i,j] = u_new[i,j]
            end
        end
        
        push!(errors, max_change)
        
        if max_change < tol
            println("Zbieżność osiągnięta po ", iter, " iteracjach")
            println("Końcowy błąd: ", max_change)
            break
        end
        if iter == max_iter
            println("Osiągnięto maksymalną liczbę iteracji: ", max_iter)
        end
    end
    return u, errors
end

function create_coordinate_grids(N::Int, L::Float64)
    x = range(0, L, length=N)
    y = range(0, L, length=N)
    return x, y
end

function plot_results(u, x, y, errors)
    # Mapa kolorów odkształcenia
    p1 = heatmap(x, y, u', 
                 title="Odkształcenie membrany h(x,y)",
                 xlabel="x", ylabel="y",
                 color=:viridis,
                 aspect_ratio=:equal)
    
    # Wykres 3D powierzchni
    p2 = surface(x, y, u',
                 title="Powierzchnia odkształcenia 3D",
                 xlabel="x", ylabel="y", zlabel="h(x,y)",
                 color=:viridis)
    
    # Linie poziomicowe
    p3 = contour(x, y, u',
                 title="Linie poziomicowe odkształcenia",
                 xlabel="x", ylabel="y",
                 fill=true,
                 color=:viridis)
    
    # Zbieżność algorytmu
    p4 = plot(1:length(errors), errors,
              title="Zbieżność metody SOR",
              xlabel="Liczba iteracji",
              ylabel="Maksymalny błąd",
              yscale=:log10,
              linewidth=2,
              color=:red)
    
    plot(p1, p2, p3, p4, layout=(2,2), size=(800, 600))
end

function analyze_solution(u, x, y, p, T)
    
    println("\n" * "="^50)
    println("ANALIZA ROZWIĄZANIA")
    println("Odkształcenia są bez znaków, wgięcia w dół")
    println("="^50)
    
    max_deflection = maximum(u)
    min_deflection = minimum(u)
    center_deflection = u[div(N,2), div(N,2)]
    boundary_max = max(maximum(u[1,:]), maximum(u[end,:]), maximum(u[:,1]), maximum(u[:,end]))
    
    println("Maksymalne odkształcenie: ", round(abs(min_deflection), digits=6))
    println("Minimalne odkształcenie: ", round(max_deflection, digits=6))
    println("Odkształcenie w centrum: ", round(abs(center_deflection), digits=6))
    println("Maksymalna wartość na brzegu: ", round(boundary_max, digits=8))
    println("="^50)
end

const L = 1.0
const p = 10.0
const T = 100.0
const N = 50
const ω = 2 / (1 + sqrt(1-cos(pi/N)^2))
const tol = 1e-6
const max_iter = 10000 


println("ROZWIĄZYWANIE RÓWNANIA POISSONA METODĄ SOR")
println("Odkształcenie membrany kwadratowej")
println("="^50)

source_term = -p/T
println("Parametry problemu:")
println("- Długość boku L = ", L)
println("- Ciśnienie p = ", p)
println("- Napięcie T = ", T)  
println("- Źródło f = -p/T = ", source_term)
println("- Rozmiar siatki: ", N, "×", N)
println("- Tolerancja: ", tol)
println("- Współczynnik relaksacji ω = ", ω)
println("- Maksymalna liczba iteracji: ", max_iter)
println("="^50)

x, y = create_coordinate_grids(N, L)

u, errors = sor_poisson_2d(N, source_term, ω, tol, max_iter)

analyze_solution(u, x, y, p, T)

plot_results(u, x, y, errors)
